prompt: Audit the staking contract at /Users/EBmic/membrane-core/contracts/staking/ for security vulnerabilities. This contract manages MBRN token staking with governance delegation, revenue distribution, lock mechanisms, and affiliate fee tracking. Focus on reward distribution bugs, unbounded iterations, duplicate claim vectors, and access control. Produce a structured security report.

assertions.name: has-structured-report
assertions.description: Output follows a structured report format with headers, severity levels, and locations

assertions.name: has-severity-classifications
assertions.description: Each finding has a severity level (Critical/Major/Minor/Informational)

assertions.name: has-code-locations
assertions.description: Findings reference specific file paths and line numbers or function names

assertions.name: has-executive-summary
assertions.description: Report includes a summary overview of total findings by severity

assertions.name: identifies-unbounded-loops
assertions.description: Flags loops over collections that could grow without size limits

assertions.name: checks-reward-distribution
assertions.description: Analyzes reward calculation and distribution logic for correctness

assertions.name: checks-duplicate-claims
assertions.description: Looks for Vec parameters without deduplication in claim/batch functions

assertions.name: reviews-delegation-access
assertions.description: Checks delegation and governance function authorization
